goal: Speed up wallet rescans by parallelizing block-filter matching, cutting wait times up to 8x on multi-core machines
Helps wallet users and integrators with large wallets or long rescan ranges who otherwise wait hundreds of seconds
reviewability: Stale, needs rebase onto the now-merged prerequisite #34681 before further review is productive
Author has been silent for roughly 56 days and the PR is a draft pending rebase
agreement: Strong concept support with independently reproduced benchmarks of 4.5-6.5x and up to 8x speedup (w0xlt, ismaelsadeeq, rkrux, l0rinc)
Architectural objection about shared thread-pool contention was resolved by redesign to a scan-local pool (bvbfan, rkrux)
Suggestion to split into building-block PRs first was followed and merged separately (furszy)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because slow rescans are a well-known wallet pain point and this PR delivers a substantial, verified speedup
Benefit felt by all wallet users and integrators using block filter indexes during rescanblockchain or wallet load
Not P1 since it is a performance gain rather than a fund-safety or consensus fix, though correctness under concurrent keypool top-ups still warrants careful review
